items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: And I heard this little young tenor player, Ricky Ford; he has the right mental attitude.

ctx.x: To return to more recent months here, I was curious to know--both from your being back here on these three occasions and I know you also keep up with the music down there in Charlottesville--what are some of the younger players that have impressed you most, either saxophone players or whoever?

Well John Hicks and Walter Booker, because they have the right mental attitude. And I heard this little young tenor player, Ricky Ford; he has the right mental attitude. And, well you know that I was so busy since I been here that I haven't had really a chance to get around to hear, you know, a lot of the people that I would like to hear, but those three people, yeah, you know the younger people.
